findings.notes: ENGINE_SELECTION in mutation_contract.py contains 14 engines for mutation testing, but VerificationRegistry only has 10 default capabilities. The mutation engines are not registered as verification capabilities. This is a GAP - the mutation engine selection is separate from the capability registry.

conclusion.notes: Capability registry exists with 10 default capabilities. ENGINE_SELECTION has 14 engines for mutation but these are not registered as capabilities. Two separate capability registries exist (VerificationRegistry and CapabilityContractRegistry). Capability graph has hardcoded pipeline spine edges. Capability-to-production mapping is present for the 10 registered capabilities but missing for the 9 additional mutation engines.
